sections.text: Families and older people on low incomes are among the hardest hit by huge increases to the cost of living. Where we work in Tower Hamlets, East London, half of all children and elderly people live in poverty; this means the cost-of-living crisis is putting further pressure onto families and households who already struggle to make ends meet.

With your support we can help people on low incomes save money, claim benefits, access a range of advice services while supporting people to improve their skills, wellbeing and make social connections in the local area.
However you choose to give, we are incredibly grateful for your support. In giving towards our work you’re helping empower people in the East End to build a fairer and happier society.
You can donate online right now, and use one of the options below to get your gift to us. You can make a one-time donation or set up a recurring payment.

You can send a donation (by cheque or CAF Voucher) to: The Fundraising Team Toynbee Hall 28 Commercial Street London E1 6LS. Please make sure you include a covering note with your details, so we can acknowledge your donation and say thank you.
Please email or call us to find out how to make a bank transfer to Toynbee Hall or set up a regular Standing Order or Direct Debit: Email: fundraising@toynbeehall.org.uk or Call: 020 7392 2970
You can understand more about how we use personal data by visiting our Data Protection, Privacy and GDPR Page.
Sign up to our quarterly e-newsletter

Toynbee Hall needs the contact information you provide to contact you about with the latest news, events and updates. You may unsubscribe from these communications at any time. For information on how to unsubscribe as well as our privacy practices and commitment to protecting your privacy, you can read our data protection policy here.
